Brief assumed Oil would be bullish, but today Crude Oil (WTI) dropped 8.80% and Brent Crude dropped 13.05% instead.

lessons: Ketika IHSG diprediksi Bearish (confidence 65%) karena Rupiah melemah dan geopolitik, tetapi IHSG justru Bullish (+0.32%), maka sentimen negatif mungkin diimbangi oleh faktor positif yang tidak teridentifikasi atau diabaikan.

Ketika sinyal komoditas Oil diprediksi bullish, tetapi Crude Oil (WTI) turun 8.80% dan Brent Crude turun 13.05%, maka prediksi arah komoditas perlu ditinjau ulang dengan data real-time yang lebih akurat.

Ketika sektor Transportation & Logistics dan Basic Materials diprediksi Bullish, tetapi sektor transportasi turun 1.43% dan sektor barang baku turun 2.61%, maka analisis sektor perlu mempertimbangkan dampak pergerakan komoditas terkait.
summary: The morning brief incorrectly predicted a bearish IHSG, which actually closed bullish by 0.32%, and significantly misjudged the direction of oil prices, which saw a sharp decline instead of the predicted bullish trend, while sector predictions were mixed.
